body: The air clings to my skin, heavy with the bitter scent of ozone. My heart beats faster, the electricity in the air a reminder of the storm's raw power. I glance around, my eyes adjusting to the dimly lit space, searching for the source of the smell. My mind flashes with images of fallen power lines, broken wires, and maybe even a downed tree branch somewhere in the cellar.
